name: Doodle
description: Doodle is a scheduling service for coordinating meetings without long email exchanges. People use group polls, booking pages, one-to-one invitations, and sign-up sheets to find suitable times and connect bookings with their calendars.
agentUseSummary: Doodle cannot be offered as a public Relay connection because Doodle no longer supports new API access; surviving API access is limited to previously configured Enterprise accounts and is licensed only for the customer's internal business use.

blocked.label: Connect a Doodle account
blocked.description: Doodle no longer supports new API access, so Relay Console cannot register a distributable OAuth application or offer a public account connection.

blocked.label: Use Doodle account data
blocked.description: Previously configured Enterprise API access is customer-specific, non-transferable, and limited to internal business use rather than a public third-party integration contract.

blocked.label: Run Doodle agent actions
blocked.description: Relay Console cannot reuse another enterprise customer's legacy access, treat Doodle's Zapier support as a general account API, or reverse engineer private endpoints.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without new, distributable Doodle API access and a supported technical contract.

runtimeSupport.description: Doodle no longer supports new API access, and no supported public remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
Doodle no longer supports new API access, and no supported public remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Doodle's official help center states that it no longer supports new API access. Existing API access is confined to previously configured Enterprise accounts, while Doodle's terms make such access non-transferable and solely for the customer's internal business use unless separately agreed in writing.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider Doodle only if Doodle reopens a supported distributable API program and grants Relay Console current documentation and application credentials.

evidence.supports: Doodle describes a scheduling service built around group polls, sign-up sheets, one-to-one invitations, booking pages, calendar coordination, and time protection.
Doodle's official API deprecation notice states that Doodle no longer supports new API and directs only Enterprise customers who already configured API access to support.
Doodle's terms limit granted API access to the user's internal business purposes and describe the license as non-transferable and non-sublicensable unless Doodle separately agrees in writing.
Doodle documents user-facing calendar, conferencing, Stripe, and Zapier integrations, but these do not create a public Doodle account API for external applications.
